topics.topic: The Doorway Effect (Event Boundaries in Psychology)
topics.hook: Have you ever walked into a room and instantly forgotten why you went there?
topics.why_watch: It addresses a universal, daily quirk that everyone experiences, offering a fascinating neurological explanation that validates the viewer's experience.

topics.hook: Our entire galaxy is currently being dragged across space toward an invisible point at 2 million km/h.
topics.why_watch: High existential curiosity and cosmic scale; viewers love cosmic anomalies and mysteries that science hasn't fully cracked.

topics.hook: There is a creature on Earth that never dies of old age—it literally resets its body to childhood.
topics.why_watch: The concept of biological immortality challenges basic human understanding of life and death, sparking instant curiosity.

topics.hook: If a storm from 1859 hit Earth today, the global internet and power grid would fry in under 20 hours.
topics.why_watch: Combines science with high-stakes 'what if' survival intrigue without crossing into sensationalized misinformation.

topics.hook: Ancient Roman structures survived 2,000 years underwater, while modern bridges crack in decades.
topics.why_watch: Contrasts ancient ingenuity against modern technology, tapping into viewers' fascination with 'lost' ancient engineering secrets.

topics.hook: Your brain actively deletes about 40 minutes of visual footage from your life every single day.
topics.why_watch: Provides a mind-bending revelation about how the human brain edits reality in real-time, easily testable by the viewer on the spot.

topics.hook: In 1901, divers found a 2,000-year-old geared computer that shouldn't have existed for another thousand years.
topics.why_watch: It is a verified historical anomaly that feels like science fiction, appealing to history and tech enthusiasts alike.

topics.topic: What If the Moon Vanished Overnight?
topics.hook: If the Moon disappeared right now, Earth's days would shrink to 6 hours and the seasons would go extinct.
topics.why_watch: Simple, dramatic thought experiment that breaks down celestial physics into immediate consequences on everyday life.

topics.hook: Creatures at the bottom of the ocean grow up to 10 times larger than their shallow-water cousins.
topics.why_watch: Deep-ocean footage has natural retention power due to the fear and wonder associated with alien-like marine ecosystems.

topics.hook: Ever learn a rare fact and suddenly hear it three times the same week? Your brain is glitching.
topics.why_watch: Explains a relatable cognitive illusion that viewers frequently encounter and often confuse with supernatural synchronicities.
